title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment Banking Intern em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Python/Cloud Platform Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

title: Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced IntelliMatch (DIM) Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our reconciliation platform. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise , playing a key role in delivering scalable and efficient reconciliation solutions across global banking systems.

You will act as a technical authority , guiding development, support, and functional teams while ensuring best practices, performance, and architectural integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for IntelliMatch (DIM) solutions
  • Lead hands-on development , including configurations, enhancements, and automation
  • Design and implement SQL-based reconciliation logic and workflows
  • Establish and enforce technical standards and best practices
  • Drive integration strategies between IntelliMatch and upstream/downstream systems
  • Act as technical lead during delivery , ensuring quality across implementation, testing, and release
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on backlog prioritization and solution planning
  • Analyze existing systems to identify performance and architectural improvements
  • Maintain detailed architecture documentation and design artifacts

✅ Must-Have (Non-Negotiable Skills)

  • ✔ IntelliMatch (DIM) experience (Version 20+)
  • ✔ Strong hands-on experience in IntelliMatch architecture & development
  • ✔ Advanced SQL / MS SQL Server expertise
  • ✔ Experience in reconciliation / financial systems
  • ✔ Ability to work hands-on + architect-level

⭐ Good to Have

  • Experience with PowerShell / Python scripting
  • Exposure to Azure / cloud platforms
  • Experience with JIRA / Agile methodologies
  • Banking or financial services domain experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science / Software Engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in IntelliMatch (DIM) or similar reconciliation platforms
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Scrum Master - Júnior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).

  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Professor de inglês empresarial
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês empresarial em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. Nosso diferencial é a abordagem personalizada dos idiomas, com aulas de 60 minutos com professores exclusivos e o uso de plataformas online com conteúdos balizados internacionamente onde adaptamos o aprendizado às necessidades específicas do ambiente corporativo e/ou acadêmico de cada aluno.

Descrição do Cargo: Se você é um professor curioso, dinâmico, que não se acomodou com a mesma metodologia há anos e busca inovar nas suas aulas, gosta de tecnologia, busca conteúdos atualizados na internet e usa IA de forma criativa, este anúncio é para você!

Estamos contratando Professor (es) (as) de Inglês Empresarial para ministrar aulas de forma remota. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência.
  • Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações.
  • Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos.
  • Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo.
  • Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo.
  • Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

title: Desenvolvedor RPA UiPath
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor RPA UiPath em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.


Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedor(a) RPA sobre a plataforma UIPATH para nos apoiar em um projeto estratégico junto com uma equipe de analistas e desenvolvedores.


Essa pessoa desenvolvedora irá atuar tecnicamente o time de automatização onde estará inserida. Irá atuar no ciclo de desenvolvimento de RPA desde a revisão da documentação do analista de negócios, análise crítica da complexidade de desenvolvimento, suporte ao desenho e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento da automação até as fases de teste, implementação do robô em produção, hypercare, orquestração e sustentação. Deverá apoiar da difusão de boas e melhores práticas a partir de sua célula de desenvolvimento junto às áreas técnicas e de negócios. Essa pessoa será treinada em nosso framework exclusivo de desenvolvimento e metodologia de Hyperautomation, o SmartBPA® que atua desde o Discovery até a implantação do COE.


Trabalhara no desenvolvimento de automatizações de média e alta complexidade baseadas no software UIPATH para processos transacionais com foco em aumento de produtividade e qualidade.


O que buscamos?

  • Pessoa com vivência e experiência em RPA;
  • Pessoa com abordagem consultiva e colaborativa;
  • Pessoa que goste de trabalhar em um ambiente que favorece a competência, transparência e confiança;


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Vivência e experiência em desenvolvimento RPA com a plataforma UIPATH
  • UiPath Certified RPA Associate (UiRPA) ou UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD)
  • Outras certificações RPA;
  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Administração;


Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Desenvolvimento em RPA segundo boas e melhores práticas;
  • Entendimento da estrutura e papel do COE;
  • Integração de scripts, conforme necessário;
  • Parametrização no UIPATH Orchestrator;
  • Ampla experiência no UIPATH Studio;
  • Uso de Assets e Queue;
  • Uso de Licenças;
  • Integração de diferentes tipos de Robô;
  • Conhecimento Pacotes e Libraries;
  • Conhecimentos em UIPATH Studio e UIPATH StudioX
  • Gestão de Filas;
  • Desenvolvimento de documentos Padronizado (PDD e SDD);
  • Uso do frameworks;
  • Aplicação de Modern Activities;
  • Experiência com Banco de Dados, Office e OCR;
  • Vivência na metodologia Ágil, tendo como utilização principal Scrum e Kanban;


Desejado, além dos requisitos para vaga, conhecimento em:

  • · Python
  • · .Net
  • · Power BI
  • · Bizagi
  • · GIT
  • · CoE
  • · Inglês


Forma de contratação / Ambiente de Trabalho

  • Contratação PJ
  • Trabalho inicialmente remoto com possibilidade de ser híbrido no escritório em São Paulo ou eventualmente em cliente.

title: Consultor (a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor (a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Run: Graças à nossa experiência global em processamento de salários, oferecemos aos nossos clientes vários níveis de externalização de salários.


O que estamos buscando:

Profissional fará parte do time de consultores funcionais do Sistema SuccessFactors módulo Employee Central, e irá atuar na implementação de projetos, melhorias ou suporte.

Deve ter o conhecimento no software em questão, além de um perfil voltado ao pensamento crítico e solução de problemas com grande atenção aos detalhes. Como o suporte ao usuário final e o trabalho em equipe são aspectos importantes do papel, são necessárias excelentes habilidades de comunicação e de pessoas e também deve ter excelentes habilidades de organização.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação do Employee Central e Benefícios, projetos de melhorias e no atendimento de suporte a clientes (AMS);
  • Treinar usuários finais, incluindo profissionais de RH, sobre como usar o SuccessFactors Employee Central e quaisquer funcionalidades relacionadas.
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias no sistema com base no feedback dos usuários e na evolução das necessidades de negócios.
  • Treinar e capacitar pessoas da equipe no módulo Employee Central;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para implementar as soluções propostas;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as últimas liberações e produtos da SAP que envolvem o SuccessFactors Employee Central.


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade para atuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

description:

Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Certificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.).
  • Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE.
  • Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão.
  • Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP.
  • Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot


Work Environment & Team Culture

• Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations

• Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture

• Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed

• Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail

• Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration

• Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions

• Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls

• Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraints


What Success Looks Like

• Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns

• Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment

• Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features

• Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture

• Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of our mobile application development effort. You will serve as the technical anchor for a cross-functional team, ensuring architectural integrity, mentoring developers, and bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution. You will work closely with product owners, QA, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality, scalable mobile product.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own the end-to-end technical design for Android and iOS mobile applications
  • Define and enforce development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices across the team
  • Lead sprint planning, technical grooming, and estimation sessions in JIRA
  • Create, manage, and prioritize JIRA epics, user stories, and technical tasks
  • Collaborate with Backend Developer to design RESTful/GraphQL APIs and data contracts
  • Drive CI/CD pipeline strategy and release management processes
  • Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to senior and mid-level developers
  • Partner with Sr. SDET to define test automation strategies using Selenium and Playwright
  • Identify and remediate technical debt proactively
  • Communicate technical risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency in UX/UI behavior and performance benchmarks
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineering staff


Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 4 years in a technical lead role
  • Deep expertise in mobile application development (Android and/or iOS)
  • Proven experience designing scalable microservices and RESTful API architectures
  • Strong proficiency with JIRA including epics, sprints, backlogs, and reporting
  • Experience integrating Selenium and/or Playwright in mobile/web test automation pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bitrise
  • Demonstrated practice and advocacy of Test Driven Development (TDD) across engineering teams
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Excellent communication and technical leadership skills
  • Experience leading both Android and iOS native development teams simultaneously
  • Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform or React Native cross-platform frameworks
  • Background in mobile security practices and OWASP Mobile Top 10
  • Experience with mobile observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics or Datadog

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer III em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Posição temporária!


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview

We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.


You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .


What You’ll Do

  • Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
  • Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred; Jenkins/GitHub Actions acceptable)
  • Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths”
  • Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
  • Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
  • Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
  • Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
  • Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
  • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles
  • Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise :
  • Operating and maintaining clusters
  • Experience building Kubernetes environments
  • Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
  • Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong Linux fundamentals
  • Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GitLab CI
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry
  • API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
  • Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
  • Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
  • Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
  • Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations


What We’re NOT Looking For

  • No Kubernetes experience ❌
  • Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
  • Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
  • Pure security-focused candidates ❌
  • Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
  • ML/Data Science profiles ❌


Team Structure

  • 1 Principal Engineer
  • 1 Senior Engineer
  • 1 Engineer (India)
  • You = 4th key team member

description:

Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview

We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.


You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .


What You’ll Do

  • Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
  • Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred; Jenkins/GitHub Actions acceptable)
  • Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths”
  • Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
  • Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
  • Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
  • Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
  • Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
  • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles
  • Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise :
  • Operating and maintaining clusters
  • Experience building Kubernetes environments
  • Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
  • Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong Linux fundamentals
  • Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GitLab CI
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry
  • API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
  • Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
  • Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
  • Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
  • Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations


What We’re NOT Looking For

  • No Kubernetes experience ❌
  • Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
  • Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
  • Pure security-focused candidates ❌
  • Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
  • ML/Data Science profiles ❌


Team Structure

  • 1 Principal Engineer
  • 1 Senior Engineer
  • 1 Engineer (India)
  • You = 4th key team member
