title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

description:

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework.   • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;

  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial Intelligence Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!

O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade.   • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos - Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.

  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em formulários (AdobeForm, Smartforms e SapScript )
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP Fiori, incluindo SAPUI5 e OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de workflows SAP.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de relatórios, interfaces, conversões, melhoramentos e formulários
  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir especificações funcionais complexas em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas de alta complexidade.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e liderar equipes técnicas.

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de back end em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

description:

We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. title: \"SAP BTP IS Cloud Integration Developer #1002182\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"SAP BTP IS Cloud Integration Developer #1002182\" em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) em SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de integrações em ambiente SAP Cloud. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir soluções robustas, apoiar times globais e garantir a estabilidade e eficiência dos fluxos de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aprimorar integration flows (iFlows) no SAP Cloud Integration, seguindo boas práticas estabelecidas.
  • Projetar e implementar cenários de integração entre sistemas SAP e não-SAP.
  • Atuar na manutenção e melhoria contínua de interfaces existentes.
  • Realizar análise de incidentes, troubleshooting e root cause analysis.
  • Apoiar equipes internas com consultoria técnica e resolução de problemas.
  • Participar de projetos de migração (ex: SAP Process Orchestration → SAP Cloud Integration)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, segurança, rede e change management.
  • Garantir governança dos artefatos, incluindo transporte, versionamento e gerenciamento de pacotes.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
  • Domínio de Graphical Mapping e uso de funções padrão.
  • Experiência com configuração e uso de adapters SAP (HTTP, OData, SFTP, IDoc, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP Integration Suite, incluindo:
  • Cloud Connector
  • Open Connectors
  • Forte entendimento de:
  • Protocolos de comunicação (HTTP, SOAP, etc.)
  • Métodos de autenticação
  • Gerenciamento de certificados (Keystore)
  • Experiência com governança de integração, incluindo:
  • Transport Management
  • Package Management
  • Externalização de parâmetros
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (obrigatório)


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Groovy Script e/ou Java EE
  • Experiência com XSLT Mapping
  • Familiaridade com OAuth, SAML e autenticação moderna
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server e linguagem SQL
  • Experiência com SAP SuccessFactors
  • Conhecimentos em Cloud Computing


Competências comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de interação com diferentes stakeholders
  • Perfil colaborativo para atuação em times ágeis
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Facilidade para aprendizado de novas tecnologias


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Delivery Manager (Internacional)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Delivery Manager (Internacional) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia e com contato direto com clientes
  • Background técnico em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: AI Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls
  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Partnership & Alliance em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Language Specialist
description:

Job Title: German Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer)

Location: Brazil (Remote – Applicants must be currently based in Brazil)

About the Role

We are seeking fluent German speakers based in Brazil to join our team as Language Specialists for AI training projects. In this role, you will contribute to the development and improvement of Large Language Models (LLMs) by ensuring high-quality German language data that is accurate, culturally relevant, and contextually appropriate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses in German for linguistic accuracy, grammar, fluency, and coherence
  • Provide structured ratings and detailed feedback on AI outputs, identifying errors, biases, and inconsistencies
  • Create, edit, and refine high-quality German-language content for AI training datasets
  • Ensure cultural nuances and regional language variations are properly represented
  • Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to enhance model performance
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines while suggesting improvements where necessary

Qualifications

  • Fluency in German (reading, writing, and speaking) is mandatory
  • Strong command of grammar, vocabulary, and stylistic nuances in German
  • Based in Brazil (required)
  • Prior experience in content writing, editing, translation, or linguistic evaluation is preferred
  • Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail
  • Interest or experience in AI, NLP, or LLM-related work is a plus

⚠️ Important Disclaimer

This role strictly requires native or near-native proficiency in German. Applications from candidates without strong German language skills will not be considered.

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Operations Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Roteirista de Redes Sociais (Finanças/Economia) para integrar nosso time na VAROS.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.


Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, criativa, com desafios diários, feedback constante e contato direto com os sócios, possibilitando uma rápida ascensão.


Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
  • Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de vídeos longos para o canal do YouTube da VAROS e/ou dos sócios (8 a 20 minutos), sobre temas de finanças, economia, geopolítica e mercado financeiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de Reels e TikToks (1 a 3 minutos) adaptando temas complexos para formatos curtos e de alto engajamento;
  • Manter consistência com o tom de voz da marca: conversacional, didático, com exemplos numéricos concretos em R$, sem jargão desnecessário;
  • Colaboração com o time de edição no intuito de garantir que a visão do roteiro seja traduzida fielmente para o vídeo final. Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing.
  • Sugerir títulos e ideias de thumbs pensados em engajamento.


Requisitos


Formação e Experiência

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
  • 3 anos ou mais de experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;
  • Portfólio com roteiros publicados;


Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura);


Soft Skills

  • Organização;
  • Criatividade


Ferramentas

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Notion;
  • IA (Claude, Perplexity);


Nós oferecemos:

  • Remuneração extremamente competitiva;

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Oracle Cloud Finance Functional Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Oracle Cloud Finance Functional Consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo

  • Experiência no setor de saúde é desejável, com bom entendimento de sistemas de saúde, operações clínicas, etc.
  • Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de forte experiência trabalhando com Oracle Cloud Financials – módulos GL, FAH, EDMCS e AR.
  • Experiência em projetos de suporte e melhorias (enhancements).
  • Experiência em desenho e implementação de soluções de sistemas para processos financeiros principais, especialmente nas áreas de Records to Report (R2R) e Order to Cash (O2C) .
  • Capacidade de liderar de forma independente o desenho e a transformação da estrutura empresarial, como mapeamento de COA (plano de contas), razão (ledger) e estrutura de unidades de negócio (BU) para empresas complexas.
  • Experiência no desenho de soluções para contabilidade regulatória, como FERC.
  • Forte habilidade na criação de modelos complexos de alocação para CAPEX, Receita e OPEX.
  • Forte experiência na configuração do Oracle Cloud GL e Accounting Hub para mapeamento de plano de contas (COA), incluindo o desenho de interfaces complexas com sistemas externos.
  • Experiência na criação de relatórios complexos utilizando SmartView, FRS, BI Publisher e OTBI.
  • Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle PaaS.
  • Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.
  • Responsável por gerenciar o desenho e a entrega ponta a ponta de objetos RICE de alto volume (Interfaces, Conversões, Extensões e Relatórios).
  • O profissional deve ter fortes habilidades de comunicação para interagir com diversos stakeholders e experiência em todas as fases do projeto: planejamento, levantamento de requisitos, análise de gaps, design, configuração, testes e treinamento, implantação e suporte.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
