title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Financial Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;

  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;

  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting.   • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation

  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Voip Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

description:

AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

description:

A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.


Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, criativa, com desafios diários, feedback constante e contato direto com os sócios, possibilitando uma rápida ascensão.


Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
  • Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
  • 3 anos ou mais de experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;

Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura);


Soft Skills

Ferramentas

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Notion;
  • IA (Claude, Perplexity);

  • Remuneração extremamente competitiva;

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BDR (Business Development Representative) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Analista de Negócios (Dados)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Negócios (Dados) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição:


• Conduzir estudos quantitativos de negócio de forma autônoma, desde a formulação de hipóteses até a extração de dados, modelagem e geração de recomendações estratégicas;

• Identificar oportunidades de crescimento no canal App por meio de análises estatísticas — correlações, segmentação de clientes, análise de propensão e modelos de regressão aplicados a comportamento de contratação;

• Acompanhar os indicadores de performance do canal digital (funil de conversão, ticket médio, volume de contratos), diagnosticando desvios e propondo ações corretivas com embasamento em dados;

• Contribuir na concepção de novas funcionalidades e jornadas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia com visão orientada a dados;

• Construir e manter dashboards analíticos em Power BI ou ferramentas similares, garantindo visibilidade dos KPIs para a liderança;

• Agir proativamente na identificação e remoção de obstáculos ao desempenho da equipe, trazendo dados como base para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:


• Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Física ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa;

• Experiência comprovada com análise estatística aplicada a negócio: correlação, regressão, testes de hipótese e significância estatística;

• Capacidade de extrair, processar e analisar dados de forma autônoma, sem dependência de time de dados dedicado;

• Domínio de SQL para consultas analíticas (incluindo joins complexos, agregações e subqueries);

• Conhecimento em Power BI e Excel avançado (modelagem de dados, DAX, tabelas dinâmicas, análises estatísticas);

• Experiência prévia em setor financeiro ou bancário, com compreensão de produtos de crédito, canais digitais ou comportamento do cliente em apps.


Desejáveis:


• Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados e modelagem estatística;

• Conhecimento em Snowflake, BigQuery ou outro data warehouse moderno;

• Vivência com testes A/B — incluindo definição de significância estatística, tamanho de amostra e interpretação dos resultados;

• Atuação prévia com canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Implementation Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Implementation Analyst


English Resume Only


Location: Brazil

Type: Full-Time Contract

Setup: Fully Remote

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos.

Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade.


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise , com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente.

Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Vaga 100% remota - Home Office


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
  • Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;
  • Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;
  • Conduzir apresentações e demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
  • Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
  • Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise;
  • Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo.


Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot.
  • Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;


O que oferecemos:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
  • Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
  • Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
  • Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
  • Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de desenvolvimento em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da transformação na Mosten

Na Mosten, transformamos desafios reais em soluções inteligentes e eficazes. Somos uma consultoria com 11 anos de história, atuando no Brasil e em Portugal, entregando soluções sob medida com foco em resultado, eficiência e evolução contínua.

Buscamos pessoas que queiram construir, propor e gerar impacto real em um ambiente colaborativo, orientado a resultados e inovação.


Sobre a posição

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior , com foco no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de soluções ligadas ao ecossistema NAVIS N4 , contribuindo diretamente para a continuidade e eficiência das operações do negócio.

A atuação será técnica e consultiva , exigindo forte capacidade de análise, autonomia e visão crítica para propor melhorias, apoiar integrações e atuar na resolução de demandas complexas. Essa pessoa terá interface com áreas internas e, conforme o contexto do projeto, também com clientes e equipes parceiras.


Principais responsabilidades

• Atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções relacionadas ao NAVIS N4

• Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações utilizando Java , Groovy e .NET

• Analisar demandas técnicas e propor soluções aderentes ao ambiente e às necessidades do negócio

• Apoiar integrações entre sistemas e garantir estabilidade nas entregas

• Atuar na identificação e correção de falhas, promovendo melhoria contínua dos serviços e aplicações

• Colaborar com áreas internas e times envolvidos no projeto, contribuindo com visão técnica e apoio consultivo

• Garantir qualidade, performance e confiabilidade nas soluções desenvolvidas


Requisitos

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software em nível sênior

• Conhecimento e atuação com NAVIS N4

• Experiência com Java

• Conhecimento em Groovy

• Vivência com .NET

• Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em demandas técnicas de maior complexidade

• Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado à resolução de problemas

• Boa comunicação e facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas


Diferenciais

• Experiência em projetos ligados a operações portuárias, logísticas ou terminais

• Vivência com integrações entre sistemas corporativos e plataformas operacionais

• Experiência em sustentação e evolução de sistemas críticos

• Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas interfaces técnicas


Modelo de trabalho

Local: Home Office

Contratação: Tempo determinado

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech - Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

* Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (CLT – Brazil | 100% Remote)


We are a US-based IT consulting firm with 30+ years of experience delivering solutions to global clients. We are currently looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to work directly with a US customer and distributed teams across the US and Latin America.


This role is fully remote (Brazil) and requires strong English communication skills.


What you will do:


  • Design and implement scalable CI/CD pipelines (Java, frontend, Appian)
  • Build pipeline-as-code using GitHub Actions, YAML, and/or Jenkins
  • Define and enforce GitHub standards (branching strategies, PR templates, code ownership)
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
  • Work with Kubernetes/OpenShift environments
  • Integrate security into pipelines (SAST, dependency scanning, secrets management)
  • Enable observability (logging, metrics, tracing – Datadog or similar)
  • Ensure compliance and consistency across environments


What we are looking for:


  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (production environments)
  • Solid experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins)
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes
  • Deep understanding of Git and modern development workflows
  • Experience integrating security and testing into pipelines
  • English proficiency for direct interaction with US-based teams


Nice to have:


  • OpenShift experience
  • Datadog or similar observability tools
  • Helm, Kustomize
  • Experience in regulated environments
  • Exposure to Appian deployments

title: Social Media Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Creator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Social Media Creator with the vision and capability to increase our social following and traffic to our site from various social platforms.


Primary responsibilities:


  • Produce engaging social content relevant to our target audience and our brand
  • Substantially increase social media engagement and follower count
  • Drive traffic to the site


We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.


DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Responsibilities


  • Create a social media strategy and calendar for various social platforms
  • Develop and execute original ideas, scripts, and concepts end-to-end
  • Craft all creatives, including messaging, design, and video
  • Produce content focused on marketing and B2B topics to drive traffic and growth
  • Utilize AI to generate content ideas and help with execution
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Build and engage a professional online community through impactful content
  • Represent the brand consistently and professionally across all platforms
  • Optimize YouTube performance through SEO, thumbnails, and high-retention content
  • Use social trends (sounds, challenges, formats) to expand reach and visibility
  • Track and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve results


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram
  • Proven experience in B2B and/or media environments.
  • Strong copywriting and storytelling skills to produce engaging, on-brand content
  • Proficient in social media tools, analytics, and video editing software
  • Progressive thinker and avid user of AI
  • Passionate about communication, creativity, and making an impact
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST


Recruitment Steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Complete a short questionnaire
  • Submit answers and CV
  • Interview with the Recruitment team
  • Complete a technical test
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager(s)
  • Receive feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Career Framework Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Career Framework Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.


Requirements:


- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.


Desired Tools Experience:


- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.


Personal Attributes:


- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.


What to Expect from Us:


- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

- Dynamic Work Culture: Innovative and multicultural environment.

- Elite Collaboration: Work with the global top 1% of talent.

- Growth and Support: Mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Recruiter Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Recruiter Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech - Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

title: Engenheiro de Soluções - Especialista BESS
description:

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
  • Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
  • Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
  • Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
  • Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
  • Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
  • Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
  • Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
  • Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
  • Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
  • Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
  • Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
  • Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
  • Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.


Habilidades Requeridas

  • Proficiência em mandarim
  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
  • Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
  • Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
  • Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
  • Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
  • Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
  • Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.


Atributos

  • Proatividade;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
  • Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
  • Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Multitarefa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
  • Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

description:
