Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Agent Manager (Media) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.

  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.

  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures

Who You Are

  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Networks Leader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: B2B Partner Comercial
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para B2B Partner Comercial em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Tem perfil hunter, busca novos horizontes na sua carreira e quer potencializar sua rede de contatos?


Então venha trabalhar no Grupo AG Capital e faça parte do modelo de atuação que está revolucionando o mercado tributário brasileiro - e moldando a carreira de centenas de executivos e empreendedores.


Quem somos


O Grupo AG Capital possui uma sólida trajetória de resultados em compliance tributário. Listada entre as empresas que mais cresceram no Brasil em 2022 e 2023 (Rankings Deloitte e Revista Exame, PWC e BTG Pactual).


Atuação com tecnologia tributária especializada, com mais de 13 mil clientes (sendo 15% das empresas listadas na B3) e mais de R$ 8 BI recuperados.


Empresas do Grupo AG Capital:


AG: Primeira TaxTech do Brasil e maior especialista no setor previdenciário desde 2010.


AG Tax: Operação especializada e com base tecnológica focada na recuperação de tributos diretos e indiretos.


Agnes: O primeiro monitor tributário de folha de pagamento e SST do Brasil. Tecnologia proprietária e pioneira a nível global.


Quem estamos buscando:


Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.


B2B Sales Partners do Grupo AG Capital contam com amplo treinamento sobre mercado e soluções, e nas reuniões com clientes é acompanhado do seu gestor comercial e profissionais da equipe técnica - com ampla estrutura tecnológica e time de suporte.


Desafios da posição


1. Desenvolvimento de novos negócios


2. Relacionamento com clientes


3. Networking qualificado


4. Estratégia de venda consultiva


5. Alianças estratégicas com rede de contatos


6. Desenvolvimento de parcerias


7. Identificação de oportunidades de negócio


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Fomentar e gerenciar sua carteira de empresas para fornecer soluções de produtos e desenvolver novos negócios (Empresas Lucro Presumido e Real);

Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes. Fornecemos todo o suporte comercial para concretização do negócio com equipe técnica alocada e ferramentas tecnológicas;

Vontade de crescer e gerar resultados, com resiliência para prospectar sempre e buscar novas oportunidades;

Trajetória de sucesso na gestão de clientes;

Familiaridade com as métricas de desempenho de vendas;

Habilidades de apresentação e comunicação e postura corporativa profissional.


Principais perfis Business Partners (palavras-chave)


Gerentes Bancos, Gerente PJ, Gerente Regional. Parceiro de Negócios, Business Partner, Consultor Empresarial, Consultor RH, Representante Comercial com Carteira (PJ). Gerente Empresas, Gerente Plataformas, Contabilidade, FOPAG. Advogado. Consultor Tributário. Executivo Comercial. Contador.

Remuneração agressiva acima do mercado.

Início imediato.


Setor


Tecnologia da informação e serviços

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst - 57510 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)


● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)


● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)


● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling


● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support


● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders


● Strong communication and coordination skills



Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.js


This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working towards engineering excellence and helping the team excel. You will collaborate across infrastructure and development teams to deliver impactful solutions.

description:

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.

At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with experience with C#/.NET and frontend TypeScript to work as a consultant out of our South American Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we expand our collaboration with one of our fastest growing North American SaaS clients.

A successful candidate in this role is capable of writing rock solid code, as well as collaborating effectively with Business Analysts and Product Managers to ensure the requirements of the business are being met.


Key Responsibilities
  • Embed within existing client development team and maintain high standards of code quality and development best practices
  • Develop, test, and deploy high-quality web applications and services using the .NET stack
  • Partner with business analysts to align on requirements, define technical scope, and drive project delivery — proactively manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations across the team
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices and design patterns (e.g., SOLID principles, Dependency Injection)
  • Participate in all phases of the agile development lifecycle, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, code reviews, and retrospectives
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software to ensure optimal performance and security
  • Contribute to technical documentation for new and existing features
  • Mentor and support junior and mid level developers on the team


Must Have Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • 2+ years of experience with C#/.NET 8+
  • Experience with .NET Framework 4.8
  • Experience with Azure cloud
  • Experience with SQL Server and Relational Databases
  • Experience with TypeScript and frontend web frameworks like Angular
  • Strong OOP knowledge


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Exposure to test automation tools such as XUnit, Moq, Autofac, Postman
  • Exposure to observability tools such as DataDog, Serilog, and OpenTelemetry
  • Exposure to containerization and Infrastructure as Code
  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design principles
  • Experience working with Azure Blob Storage and DocumentDB for unstructured and document-based data storage.
  • Openness to contributing, at least part of the time, to legacy projects in PHP and Angular
  • ​​Exposure to GitHub Actions


Benefits:

  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: FullStack Shopify Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FullStack Shopify Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crimson Agility is a full-service e-commerce services firm with an in-depth understanding of leading e-commerce platforms and a broad set of design, development, integration, and digital marketing skills. As a company, we promote a culture that values success, fairness, excellence, and professional growth.


Crimson Agility is looking for a FullStack Shopify Developer . The successful candidate will value challenging and innovative projects and take pride in their work. In this role, you will participate on a team responsible for implementing Shopify solutions and developing innovative e-commerce solutions for our clients, following best practices.


This position is available to remote candidates located only within the United States or LATAM.


WE’LL NEED YOU TO

  • Develop and implement innovative features and functionality for e-commerce using Shopify
  • Collaborate with a team of passionate e-commerce professionals to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Apply your expertise in Shopify, Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API integrations to extend, enhance, and build great user experiences. For the backend we prefer experience in PHP but other languages like Ruby are also valid.
  • Understand e-commerce business requirements and convert them into a coherent design
  • Unit test and take accountability for the quality of your work


APPLY IF YOU

  • Want to grow into a consultant capable of taking challenges from scratch and advise U.S-based businesses
  • Want to work on a diversity of B2B and B2C projects in a wide range of industries like automotive, healthcare, sports & outdoors
  • Working with a talented team of consultants, developers, and project managers
  • Are excited to work on high-traffic, high-profile websites with complex requirements
  • Are looking for a company that places value on training and skills development
  • Want to develop a career in the fast-growing industry of e-commerce


YOU MUST HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the frontend, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language, with a proven track record of designing responsive, visually appealing user interfaces.
  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the backend using languages such as PHP, Ruby, Node, etc ., including server-side logic, API integration, and database management with a focus on Shopify platform customization and app development.
  • Experience working in an Agency environment
  • Ambition and Conversational English (B2/C1)


IT’D BE A PLUS IF YOU HAD

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Any Shopify certification
  • Experience with BigCommerce


CRIMSON AGILITY OFFERS

  • Competitive Salaries (commensurate with experience, education, certifications, etc.)
  • Quarterly Team Bonuses
  • Quarterly Individual Bonuses
  • Training & Certifications
  • Opportunity to learn from some of the best E-Commerce Professionals in the industry
  • 18 Days of PTO + 5 Sick Days + 10 Paid Holidays
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance (For US-based talent)
  • 401K with Employer Match (For US-based talent)


OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is simple but complete and only has three steps:

  • Initial Interview with David Baier (Managing Partner) to check your cultural fit
  • Technical Interview with Ian Coast (Solutions Architect & Managing Partner)
  • Offer Letter

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:


  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e gestão de configuração como: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e alerta como: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins.
  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Web Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .


Sobre os projetos

Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando .NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue)
  • Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente
  • Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL
  • Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance
  • Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte conhecimento em C# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes)
  • Experiência com React, Angular ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server / Azure SQL
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente Azure)
  • Inglês avançado



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Node.js / TypeScript no backend
  • Azure Functions, App Services, API Management
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps)
  • Experiência com ETL, SAP ou integração de dados
  • Docker e microsserviços
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experiência em times ágeis distribuídos
  • Noções de data engineering ou analytics


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .


Sobre os projetos

Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando .NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue)
  • Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente
  • Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL
  • Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance
  • Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte conhecimento em C# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes)
  • Experiência com React, Angular ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server / Azure SQL
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente Azure)
  • Inglês avançado



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Node.js / TypeScript no backend
  • Azure Functions, App Services, API Management
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps)
  • Experiência com ETL, SAP ou integração de dados
  • Docker e microsserviços
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experiência em times ágeis distribuídos
  • Noções de data engineering ou analytics


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Systems Administrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

description:

Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Rate: 30-50hr USD


Required Skills & Experience


Adaptive Planning Expertise


5+ years of hands‑on Workday Adaptive Planning experience, with direct ownership of model design and builds

Proven experience architecting and building (not just maintaining) Adaptive Planning solutions

Deep expertise with:


Dimensions, sheets, versions, and assumptions

Driver‑based and complex calculation logic

Performance tuning and model optimization



Integrations & Systems

Strong understanding of data structures, planning data flows, and integration best practices


Financial & Business Acumen


Strong understanding of financial planning and FP&A processes, including budgeting and forecasting

Experience supporting SaaS or recurring‑revenue business models strongly preferred

Ability to bridge the gap between technical configuration and financial outcomes


Collaboration & Communication


Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non‑technical stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Overview

title: FullStack Shopify Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FullStack Shopify Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crimson Agility is a full-service e-commerce services firm with an in-depth understanding of leading e-commerce platforms and a broad set of design, development, integration, and digital marketing skills. As a company, we promote a culture that values success, fairness, excellence, and professional growth.


Crimson Agility is looking for a FullStack Shopify Developer . The successful candidate will value challenging and innovative projects and take pride in their work. In this role, you will participate on a team responsible for implementing Shopify solutions and developing innovative e-commerce solutions for our clients, following best practices.


This position is available to remote candidates located only within the United States or LATAM.


WE’LL NEED YOU TO

  • Develop and implement innovative features and functionality for e-commerce using Shopify
  • Collaborate with a team of passionate e-commerce professionals to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Apply your expertise in Shopify, Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API integrations to extend, enhance, and build great user experiences. For the backend we prefer experience in PHP but other languages like Ruby are also valid.
  • Understand e-commerce business requirements and convert them into a coherent design
  • Unit test and take accountability for the quality of your work


APPLY IF YOU

  • Want to grow into a consultant capable of taking challenges from scratch and advise U.S-based businesses
  • Want to work on a diversity of B2B and B2C projects in a wide range of industries like automotive, healthcare, sports & outdoors
  • Working with a talented team of consultants, developers, and project managers
  • Are excited to work on high-traffic, high-profile websites with complex requirements
  • Are looking for a company that places value on training and skills development
  • Want to develop a career in the fast-growing industry of e-commerce


YOU MUST HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the frontend, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language, with a proven track record of designing responsive, visually appealing user interfaces.
  • 3+ years of experience with Shopify in the backend using languages such as PHP, Ruby, Node, etc ., including server-side logic, API integration, and database management with a focus on Shopify platform customization and app development.
  • Experience working in an Agency environment
  • Ambition and Conversational English (B2/C1)


IT’D BE A PLUS IF YOU HAD

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Any Shopify certification
  • Experience with BigCommerce


CRIMSON AGILITY OFFERS

  • Competitive Salaries (commensurate with experience, education, certifications, etc.)
  • Quarterly Team Bonuses
  • Quarterly Individual Bonuses
  • Training & Certifications
  • Opportunity to learn from some of the best E-Commerce Professionals in the industry
  • 18 Days of PTO + 5 Sick Days + 10 Paid Holidays
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance (For US-based talent)
  • 401K with Employer Match (For US-based talent)


OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is simple but complete and only has three steps:

  • Initial Interview with David Baier (Managing Partner) to check your cultural fit
  • Technical Interview with Ian Coast (Solutions Architect & Managing Partner)
  • Offer Letter

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Web Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco em transformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .


Sobre os projetos

Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando .NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue)
  • Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente
  • Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL
  • Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL
  • Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance
  • Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte conhecimento em C# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes)
  • Experiência com React, Angular ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server / Azure SQL
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente Azure)
  • Inglês avançado



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Node.js / TypeScript no backend
  • Azure Functions, App Services, API Management
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps)
  • Experiência com ETL, SAP ou integração de dados
  • Docker e microsserviços
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experiência em times ágeis distribuídos
  • Noções de data engineering ou analytics


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Rate: 30-50hr USD

Adaptive Planning Expertise

Collaboration & Communication

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Networks Leader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst - 57510 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
