title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer - C# em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Analista de Dados Sênior AWS (Power BI)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Dados Sênior AWS (Power BI) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Profissionais com interesse em tecnologia e no universo de dados podem se cadastrar em nosso Banco de Talentos – Analista de Dados Sênior AWS (Power BI).


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto:

Busca-se profissional para atuação como Analista de Dados Sênior em projetos estratégicos, com utilização da plataforma AWS , com foco em soluções utilizando Power BI.


Perfil técnico esperado:

• Experiência consolidada em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos.

• Experiência em apoio técnico e orientação de times.

• Sólido conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados, com foco em Power BI.

• Experiência no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias analíticas.

• Conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional.

• Experiência no levantamento e análise de requisitos.

• Habilidade para consumo e tratamento de dados em ambientes de Big Data.

• Experiência com Data Warehouses (Amazon Redshift).

• Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouse (Amazon S3, Athena e Glue).

• Conhecimento e experiência em ambientes e serviços AWS.

• Habilidades de comunicação e interação com áreas de negócio.


Diferenciais:

• Espanhol desejável.


Escopo de atuação:

• Atuação no levantamento e validação de requisitos de negócio.

• Atuação na modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e física).

• Execução de projetos analíticos, da concepção à entrega.

• Desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de análise de dados.

• Interação com áreas de negócio para identificação de oportunidades analíticas.

• Elaboração e apresentação de insights e recomendações para stakeholders.

description:

Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o principal responsável por transformar dados de comportamento digital em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. Atuará como referência técnica em mensuração e análise de performance web, garantindo que as decisões de produto, marketing e experiência do usuário sejam guiadas por dados confiáveis e bem interpretados. Seu trabalho conecta diretamente o que acontece nas propriedades digitais com os resultados que a empresa busca atingir.



Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios de performance digital, acompanhando métricas como tráfego, conversão, engajamento e funis de aquisição
  • Implementar e auditar tags de rastreamento via Google Tag Manager, garantindo a integridade da coleta de dados nas propriedades digitais
  • Realizar análises exploratórias e apresentar insights para times de produto, marketing e liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações utilizáveis
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de produto e UX para definir eventos de rastreamento, apoiar testes A/B e interpretar resultados de experimentos
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia e BI para estruturar pipelines de dados e garantir a disponibilidade das informações nas ferramentas certas
  • Disseminar a cultura de dados dentro da organização, apoiando outras áreas na utilização e interpretação de métricas digitais



Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Sólida experiência com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Conhecimento em configuração, implantação e estruturação de dataLayer via código (Javascript) ou Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Domínio de SQL para extração e análise de dados em ambientes de Data Warehouse (BigQuery, Amazon Redshift ou similar)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização como Looker Studio, Quicksight, Power BI ou Tableau
  • Capacidade de comunicar análises e recomendações de forma clara para públicos não técnicos
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de mensuração digital: eventos, dimensões, métricas, atribuição e modelos de funil
  • Perfil analítico com autonomia para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta com poucos direcionamentos
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban
  • Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.



Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística)
  • Conhecer ferramentas de análise de comportamento como Hotjar, Clarity ou similares
  • Vivência com plataformas de CRM Analytics ou dados de mídia paga integrados ao contexto de web analytics (Insider One, Salesforce)
  • Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4)
  • Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS)
  • Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking)
  • Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

description:

Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo! A EasyJur é uma Legaltech com missão de revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio de inteligência humana e artificial. Todo advogado que adota o #easyjur como solução central percebe rapidamente os benefícios da transformação digital. Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para construir não apenas um software jurídico — mas um mundo mais justo. Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!


O que a gente espera de você?

Buscamos um SDR Sênior que queira ser protagonista em um time comercial de alta performance estruturado em Sales PODs. A pessoa ideal tem visão de processo, opera com autonomia, e entende que prospecção de qualidade não é volume e sim diagnóstico.

Você será responsável por construir e qualificar pipeline com precisão, garantindo que cada lead que avança para o Closer chegue com contexto real, dor mapeada e próximo passo claro.


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Executar cadências de qualificação de inbound, segmentadas por perfil de ICP e nível de consciência do lead, utilizando o HubSpot.
  • Conduzir as primeiras conversas com foco em diagnóstico inicial: mapear Situação e Dor do potencial cliente utilizando o framework SPICED como guia de qualificação.
  • Operar e alimentar agentes de comunicação (IA) integrados ao fluxo de prospecção, garantindo que a automação potencialize a abordagem consultiva.
  • Registrar e manter a higiene dos dados no HubSpot em tempo real, documentando interações, estágio do lead e sinalizadores de qualificação com rigor.
  • Realizar o handoff qualificado para o Closer com o SPICED parcialmente preenchido e o contexto necessário para uma reunião de Discovery de alto nível.
  • Atuar em colaboração direta dentro do Sales POD, participando de dailies com o Closer e o CSM para destravar oportunidades e alinhar estratégias de abordagem.
  • Contribuir com a construção e melhoria contínua dos scripts, cadências e critérios de descarte, com base em dados e feedback do funil.


O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico?

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em SDR ou Inside Sales B2B.
  • Familiaridade com o framework SPICED (ou metodologias de vendas baseadas em impacto como MEDDIC, MEDDPICC) e mentalidade diagnóstica antes de prescrever.
  • Domínio operacional do HubSpot: gestão de sequências, propriedades de contato, leadscore e relatórios de funil.
  • Experiência ou abertura real para operar com agentes de IA/automação de comunicação integrados ao processo de prospecção.
  • Capacidade de argumentação consultiva: entender o negócio do lead o suficiente para qualificar com precisão, não apenas agendar reunião.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de gerar interesse genuíno no primeiro contato.
  • Compreensão de métricas de funil SaaS: MQL, SAL, SQL, taxa de conversão por etapa e ciclo médio de vendas.


O que gostaríamos, porém não é obrigatório:

  • Experiência com SaaS jurídico ou vendas para o mercado de escritórios de advocacia e departamentos jurídicos.
  • Familiaridade com a estrutura de trabalho em Sales PODs ou squads ágeis.
  • Conhecimento sobre OKRs e como o resultado individual conecta às metas do time.


O que você pode esperar de nós:

  • Um time que opera com metodologia real: POD estruturado e cultura de melhoria contínua baseada em dados.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade, você vai ter espaço para propor, testar e iterar.
  • Ambiente de alta performance onde o crescimento individual é tanto uma expectativa quanto um investimento da empresa.
  • Acesso a tecnologia de ponta no processo comercial, incluindo IA integrada ao fluxo de trabalho.


Benefícios:


  • Programa EasyFamily
  • Programa Saúde e bem estar - Plano de saúde, plano odontológico, atividade física e apoio psicológico;
  • Apoio internet backup (Remotos)
  • Day off em seu aniversário;
  • Bônus por indicação de novos colaboradores e/ou prestadores de serviços.
  • Bolsa de 50% para curso de inglês;
  • Bolsa para especializações e estudos;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento;
  • Possibilidade de contrato stock options;

• Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua.

• Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR).

• Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas.

• Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal.

• Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.


Requisitos:

• Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA.

• Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting.

• Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

• Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer).

• Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.).

• Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares.

• Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade).

• Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares).

• Habilidades de comunicação para colaborar com times multidisciplinares e interagir com clientes. • Certificações em AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes ou áreas correlatas são altamente desejáveis.


Desejáveis:

• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta disponibilidade (produtos de larga escala).

• Atuação anterior em equipes de SRE ou como engenheiro responsável por confiabilidade de sistemas críticos.

• Conhecimentos de FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.


Vantagens:

• Programa de mentoria que te acompanha durante sua fase de adaptação;

• Vaga 100% remota;

• Acesso a cursos e certificações;

• Aulas de inglês custeada pela empresa.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you’ll jump to the front of the line.

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location : Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:

Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo! A EasyJur é uma Legaltech com missão de revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio de inteligência humana e artificial. Todo advogado que adota o #easyjur como solução central percebe rapidamente os benefícios da transformação digital. Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para construir não apenas um software jurídico — mas um mundo mais justo. Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!


O que a gente espera de você?

Buscamos um SDR Sênior que queira ser protagonista em um time comercial de alta performance estruturado em Sales PODs. A pessoa ideal tem visão de processo, opera com autonomia, e entende que prospecção de qualidade não é volume e sim diagnóstico.

Você será responsável por construir e qualificar pipeline com precisão, garantindo que cada lead que avança para o Closer chegue com contexto real, dor mapeada e próximo passo claro.


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Executar cadências de qualificação de inbound, segmentadas por perfil de ICP e nível de consciência do lead, utilizando o HubSpot.
  • Conduzir as primeiras conversas com foco em diagnóstico inicial: mapear Situação e Dor do potencial cliente utilizando o framework SPICED como guia de qualificação.
  • Operar e alimentar agentes de comunicação (IA) integrados ao fluxo de prospecção, garantindo que a automação potencialize a abordagem consultiva.
  • Registrar e manter a higiene dos dados no HubSpot em tempo real, documentando interações, estágio do lead e sinalizadores de qualificação com rigor.
  • Realizar o handoff qualificado para o Closer com o SPICED parcialmente preenchido e o contexto necessário para uma reunião de Discovery de alto nível.
  • Atuar em colaboração direta dentro do Sales POD, participando de dailies com o Closer e o CSM para destravar oportunidades e alinhar estratégias de abordagem.
  • Contribuir com a construção e melhoria contínua dos scripts, cadências e critérios de descarte, com base em dados e feedback do funil.


O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico?

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em SDR ou Inside Sales B2B.
  • Familiaridade com o framework SPICED (ou metodologias de vendas baseadas em impacto como MEDDIC, MEDDPICC) e mentalidade diagnóstica antes de prescrever.
  • Domínio operacional do HubSpot: gestão de sequências, propriedades de contato, leadscore e relatórios de funil.
  • Experiência ou abertura real para operar com agentes de IA/automação de comunicação integrados ao processo de prospecção.
  • Capacidade de argumentação consultiva: entender o negócio do lead o suficiente para qualificar com precisão, não apenas agendar reunião.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de gerar interesse genuíno no primeiro contato.
  • Compreensão de métricas de funil SaaS: MQL, SAL, SQL, taxa de conversão por etapa e ciclo médio de vendas.


O que gostaríamos, porém não é obrigatório:

  • Experiência com SaaS jurídico ou vendas para o mercado de escritórios de advocacia e departamentos jurídicos.
  • Familiaridade com a estrutura de trabalho em Sales PODs ou squads ágeis.
  • Conhecimento sobre OKRs e como o resultado individual conecta às metas do time.


O que você pode esperar de nós:

  • Um time que opera com metodologia real: POD estruturado e cultura de melhoria contínua baseada em dados.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade, você vai ter espaço para propor, testar e iterar.
  • Ambiente de alta performance onde o crescimento individual é tanto uma expectativa quanto um investimento da empresa.

title: Especialista de Conteúdo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Conteúdo em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar
  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

description:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de Infra. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, implementar e gerenciar a infraestrutura de rede para garantir a disponibilidade e o desempenho dos serviços de TI.
  • Monitorar o tráfego de rede e resolver problemas de conectividade e desempenho.
  • Configurar e manter firewalls, switches, roteadores e outros equipamentos de rede.

  • falhas.

  • e servidores.

description:

  • Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis em cloud (Azure Fabric, Databricks)

  • Bus)

  • ● Implementar monitoramento e observabilidade (Application Insights)
  • ● Documentação e Colaboração
  • ● Documentar arquiteturas com diagramas técnicos

● PySpark / Apache Spark (transformações complexas, window functions, joins)

● SQL avançado (CTEs, window functions, otimização)

● Azure (Event Hubs, Storage, Data Factory, Key Vault)

● Modelagem dimensional e normalização

● Git e CI/CD

● Kafka e streaming em tempo reale NRT

● Microsoft Purview

OUTROS DIFERENCIAIS

● Redução de custos operacionais e FinOps

● Certificações Azure (DP-203, AZ-305)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Business System Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business System Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Central and South America Fully Remote

Rate: $19/hr - $23/hr



Job Description

Insight Global is seeking a Business Systems Analyst to support AI‑driven transformation initiatives across underwriting, claims, and operations at a commercial insurance company. This role will act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring AI solutions are aligned to real operational needs and deliver measurable value. Day‑to‑day, the BSA will gather and document detailed business requirements, perform gap analysis and process mapping, define future‑state workflows enabled by AI, and partner with QA and delivery teams on testing and validation. The ideal candidate brings strong business analysis experience on technical projects and excels at translating business problems into clear, actionable requirements. The successful candidate will have a business focused functional background and is expected to leverage the technical/AI focused team members to develop solutions. We are seeking an international resource based in LATAM to work closely with a team in Canada on mountain standard time. This is a fully remote 12 month engagement.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst experience with experience working in the insurance industry

• Strong experience with requirements documentation and BRDs

• Proven experience with process mapping and gap analysis

• Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria

• Hands‑on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience working in Agile environments

description:

Contact: PJ - Long Term


About the Role

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services

  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations with APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, and project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform and/or Atlantis


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Charge Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full-Charge Bookkeeper


Remote I Part-Time I 20 hrs/week


Salary: $8-9/hour with opportunity for performance-based bonuses & raises


Golden Home Access is a mission-driven and fast-growing company based in the San Francisco Bay Area.


The United States’ aging population is growing rapidly. 90% of seniors want to stay in their home instead of moving into a senior care facility. We install essential safety and mobility equipment like stairlifts and wheelchair ramps to help seniors stay in their homes longer.


We are hiring a Full-Charge Bookkeeper to manage our bookkeeping, job costing, and AR/AP. We have a growing remote global team, including the Head of Project Management to whom you would report to.


This is a hands-on execution role. You will be responsible for running our day-to-day financial operations. You will not be responsible for financial strategy or decision-making.


Responsibilities


  • Bookkeeping: Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks. Record and categorize all transactions correctly. Complete bank and credit card reconciliations. Maintain consistency in financial reporting month over month.
  • Accounts Payable: Verify vendor invoices, schedule and process payments according to vendor terms.
  • Accounts Receivables: Monitor customer payments. Verify invoices and deposits are paid and correctly applied. Reconcile deposits to final invoices by job. Flag and resolve overdue balances and discrepancies.
  • Job Costing: Allocate labor and materials accurately to each job. Maintain job-level cost records and calculate gross margin per job.
  • Purchase Order Management: Create and enter all POs into the inventory management system.
  • Payroll Administration: Administer weekly payroll. Collect and validate timesheets. Verify payroll accuracy prior to submission.
  • Sales Tax: Track taxable and non-taxable revenue. Reconcile sales tax collected to accounting records. File and remit sales tax accurately and on time. Maintain documentation of filings and payments.
  • SOP Development: Assist in the development and formalization of all financial policies and procedures. 


You are a fit if

  • Hungry to invest in your career for the long-term and work alongside other high-performing teammates
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks
  • Organized with an extreme attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in an evolving startup business environment
  • Comfortable escalating discrepancies rather than making assumptions
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Care about helping improve the lives of the elderly and their families; can approach the job with care and empathy


As we grow, you’ll grow - in title, responsibilities, and compensation. We have a track record of consistently rewarding high performance.


We believe in hiring top tier talent, investing in their long-term professional development, and giving them the freedom to do what they do best.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

description:

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

Requirements

Must have:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Operations Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Charge Bookkeeper em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full-Charge Bookkeeper


Remote I Part-Time I 20 hrs/week


Salary: $8-9/hour with opportunity for performance-based bonuses & raises


Golden Home Access is a mission-driven and fast-growing company based in the San Francisco Bay Area.


The United States’ aging population is growing rapidly. 90% of seniors want to stay in their home instead of moving into a senior care facility. We install essential safety and mobility equipment like stairlifts and wheelchair ramps to help seniors stay in their homes longer.


We are hiring a Full-Charge Bookkeeper to manage our bookkeeping, job costing, and AR/AP. We have a growing remote global team, including the Head of Project Management to whom you would report to.


This is a hands-on execution role. You will be responsible for running our day-to-day financial operations. You will not be responsible for financial strategy or decision-making.


Responsibilities


  • Bookkeeping: Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks. Record and categorize all transactions correctly. Complete bank and credit card reconciliations. Maintain consistency in financial reporting month over month.
  • Accounts Payable: Verify vendor invoices, schedule and process payments according to vendor terms.
  • Accounts Receivables: Monitor customer payments. Verify invoices and deposits are paid and correctly applied. Reconcile deposits to final invoices by job. Flag and resolve overdue balances and discrepancies.
  • Job Costing: Allocate labor and materials accurately to each job. Maintain job-level cost records and calculate gross margin per job.
  • Purchase Order Management: Create and enter all POs into the inventory management system.
  • Payroll Administration: Administer weekly payroll. Collect and validate timesheets. Verify payroll accuracy prior to submission.
  • Sales Tax: Track taxable and non-taxable revenue. Reconcile sales tax collected to accounting records. File and remit sales tax accurately and on time. Maintain documentation of filings and payments.
  • SOP Development: Assist in the development and formalization of all financial policies and procedures. 


You are a fit if

  • Hungry to invest in your career for the long-term and work alongside other high-performing teammates
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks
  • Organized with an extreme attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in an evolving startup business environment
  • Comfortable escalating discrepancies rather than making assumptions
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Care about helping improve the lives of the elderly and their families; can approach the job with care and empathy


As we grow, you’ll grow - in title, responsibilities, and compensation. We have a track record of consistently rewarding high performance.


We believe in hiring top tier talent, investing in their long-term professional development, and giving them the freedom to do what they do best.
